record.question: 'Changsha Declaration' aims at:
record.explanation: Answer D: Agriculture and Rural Development. The 2018 Changsha Declaration focused on South–South cooperation in agriculture and rural development, supporting food security, nutrition and the SDGs. Reference: https://www.fao.org/newsroom/detail/South-South-cooperation-on-agriculture-a-key-ingredient-for-Zero-Hunger/ar. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
